1.prompt:
A chest-up photograph of <<<0ec9988e-def7-4bf8-9337-35b5e4757bf1>>>, a 25-year-old Taiwanese woman in Taipei, seen almost straight on, her face turned no more than ten degrees off the lens.

Her build: narrow shoulders and a slight frame with a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how slim the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden), visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, unretouched skin detail.

Her long dark-brown hair is completely down for the first time all day, and the lower third of its length is bleached to a soft honey-tea blonde. It is pushed back off her face so both eyebrows and her whole jawline are clearly visible.

She wears a deep grey silk slip nightdress with thin straps, the fabric creased where she has been lying on it.

She is sitting on the edge of the bed in her rented flat after a night shift. Behind her: a duvet pushed into a heap, a hair tie and a lanyard dropped on the nightstand, a glass of water, blackout curtains half drawn against the daylight.

One bedside lamp on against the daylight leaking round the curtain edge, an ordinary phone exposure, the rest of the room dim.

She looks at the lens with the flat, emptied-out expression of someone who has just come off a twelve-hour shift, lips closed.

The only person anywhere in this photograph is her — no one else in the frame, no one in any doorway, no hand or arm belonging to anybody else, no figure in any mirror or window reflection, no portrait or photograph of a person on any wall or screen. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Shot on a rear phone camera from about a metre and a half away, crisp sharp focus on her face, natural colour grading.
